decisions.collectorChecklist: 660-card wax checklist: 658 TCDB base positions plus A/B Living Legends, kept together because these were printed at the same rate as base. Factory sets omit A/B.
decisions.checklistNumbering: 1-651 plus CL-DK, CL1-CL6 and A/B. Checklist printed numbering preserved as metadata.
decisions.variations: Collapse error/correction states; use corrected numbered #29/#30 and corrected Perez-Steele backs. No extra completion requirements for print states.
decisions.exclusions: Oversized mail-order Super Diamond Kings and non-card Duke Snider puzzle panels excluded. Duke Snider #648 puzzle-image baseball card retained.
decisions.mascotTeam: #651 Famous Chicken is independent, intentionally blank team. Importer only exempts checklists; use --allow-pending-teams until mascot exception is supported.
